        From 255cfc09720e3d906586abfb50a42571e66ab110 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Yizhou Zhang <yizhou@cs.cornell.edu>

Subject: [PATCH] fixing a bug introduced in
 e4403c131f5615bfd27a224c777bab7fcf77a2e8

---
 src/polyglot/main/Options.java | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/polyglot/main/Options.java b/src/polyglot/main/Options.java
index 0feb8c58..47fe2561 100644
--- a/src/polyglot/main/Options.java
+++ b/src/polyglot/main/Options.java
@@ -763,7 +763,7 @@ public class Options {
     }
 
     protected void addBootCP(List<File> value) {
-        bootclasspathDirectories().addAll(value);
+        bootclasspathDirectories().addAll(0, value);
     }
 
     protected void setSourcepath(List<File> value) {
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect addition of elements to the `bootclasspathDirectories` list. The original code used `addAll(value)`, which appends the elements to the end of the list. This could lead to issues where the order of the classpath directories is important, as the newly added directories would not be prioritized. The fix changes this to `addAll(0, value)`, which inserts the elements at the beginning of the list, ensuring that they are processed first.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the incorrect addition of elements to the `bootclasspathDirectories` list. The original code used `addAll(value)`, which appends the elements to the end of the list. This could lead to issues where the order of the classpath directories is important, as the newly added directories would not be prioritized. The fix changes this to `addAll(0, value)`, which inserts the elements at the beginning of the list, ensuring that they are processed first.
